policy.label: Estimated 40-yard dash
policy.status: Fantasy scouting estimates authored for the game; not factual or measured results.
policy.start: Standing start, no run-up; reaction time excluded.
policy.surface: Level, dry, ordinary soft football turf in still air.
policy.movement: Fastest ordinary unaided physical locomotion in the displayed base form. Powered flight and continuous ordinary hovering are allowed. Burrowing through ordinary soft turf is allowed for habitual burrowers.
policy.equipmentAndAnatomy: Normal anatomy and inherent carried loads remain, including shells, mushrooms, bone, eggs, pouch young, and normal sack load. An evolved form may be slower when anatomy warrants it.
policy.aquaticRule: Swimmers are judged on turf using plausible unaided flops, tentacle pulls, and grounded shuffles. Water swimming speed is not substituted.
policy.method: Manually assigned from movement anatomy, launch mechanics, agility, and familiar movement lore. No battle Speed stat was read or numerically remapped.
policy.display: Show two decimals with an s suffix; label them estimates and keep that qualification on exported boards.

reviewEdges.assumption: Tiny unaided wriggles, rolls, or hops are permitted for a finite game estimate; these are not claims that a canon dash has been demonstrated.
A football turf dash may be burrowed without magic. Artificial turf or a requirement to remain above ground would change their estimates substantially.
Continuous ordinary hovering counts as movement, while instant relocation does not. A feet-only combine would need a different policy.
A Flying typing or wings alone does not guarantee powered flight from level turf. Gyarados is grounded; Mantine has no water launch; Gligar gets no high perch; Scizor runs.
Self-produced gas venting is ordinary physical propulsion, not an externally boosted or explosive launch.
Still air prevents a free wind-assisted dash; low-strength self-directed hops and lift provide conservative finite estimates.
Their signature shortcut abilities are deliberately excluded to preserve a comparable physical dash.
